meaning:
ἐκ-κεντέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for דָּקַר ;]
1. to prick out, put out (Arist.).
2. to pierce (Polyb., LXX): with accusative of person(s), Jhn.19:37 (LXX), Rev.1:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”
Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so…
